note: Three shots chosen because they are the three hardest things this film asks for: a face in close-up, a crowd in motion, and an empty landscape. The texts are the board's own shot briefs.

shots.from: S-937 · a queen in close profile
shots.text: a dark-skinned queen in an ornate gold crown and jewelled headdress, close three-quarter profile, eyes lowered, heavy shadow across one side of the face, deep indigo and violet light with a warm gold rim, ancient India

shots.from: S-851 · the procession on the road
shots.text: a chariot procession on a dust road at dusk seen from behind a horse, a column of riders and carts ahead, temple towers on the horizon, a wall of dust lit from the side, ancient India

shots.from: S-719 · the mouth of the cave
shots.text: a dark cave mouth in a dry rock gorge, one small distant figure walking into it, late afternoon sun on the stone, no people in the foreground, ancient India
